evals.prompt: I added uiSettings.register({ 'observability:enableInspectEsQueries': { name, value: false, category: ['observability'], schema } }) in a Kibana plugin. Where do I document it?
evals.expected_output: Classify as space-level Advanced Settings and add the entry to docs/reference/advanced-settings-space.yml in the Observability group, not configuration-reference YAML.
expectations: Identifies uiSettings.register as space-level Advanced Settings (scope namespace)
Does not tell the author to document the key as a kibana.yml setting

evals.prompt: We're adding xpack.fleet.agents.enabled to the Kibana config schema. Should I write ech: ga because Cloud users can set Kibana settings?
evals.expected_output: No. Grep the Elastic Cloud Hosted user-settings allowlist in elastic/cloud under scala-services/adminconsole/src/main/resources/settings/kibana/. Write ech: ga only if the key is listed. Write ech: unavailable if it is not. Do not infer from the published Cloud settings page.
expectations: Requires grepping the Cloud user-settings allowlist, not assuming Cloud support
Does not recommend node scripts/check_kibana_settings.js for the ech decision
Does not infer ech: ga from the published Cloud settings page

evals.prompt: This Advanced Settings ID is in observability_project/index.ts but not in common/index.ts. Should I write serverless: ga?
evals.expected_output: No. Nest observability: ga under serverless. Do not write a scalar serverless: ga. Map observability_project to observability.
expectations: Does NOT write a scalar serverless: ga
Nests observability under serverless with ga
Mentions checking common/index.ts first, then the project allowlists

evals.prompt: I added a kibana.yml schema field xpack.ml.enabled. A teammate put it in advanced-settings-space.yml next to the ML UI settings. Is that right?
evals.expected_output: No. kibana.yml keys go in docs/reference/configuration-reference/. Do not document a kibana.yml key in Advanced Settings YAML.
expectations: Rejects documenting a kibana.yml key in advanced-settings-space.yml
Does not treat a config-schema field as uiSettings
